/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from Bio import pairwise2
human=''
indri=''
sem=''
for name,s in [('indri',indri),('sem',sem)]:
 alns=pairwise2.align.globalms(human,s,2,-1,-5,-2)
 a=alns[0]
 print('\\n',name,'score',a.score)
 print(a.seqA)
 print(a.seqB)
 print('diffs',sum(x"'!=y for x,y in zip(a.seqA,a.seqB)))
PY'
